scope: Public auction details and authorized, anonymized post-close bidding observations; not an exhaustive payment or participant register.

notice.title: Site No-303 at Banashankari 6th Stage 11th Block Ganakallu

site.areaSource: Item specification, not the API quantity field.

pricing.qualification: Whole-plot amounts are derived from the specified 90 sq. m. Highest observed bid is not proof of acceptance or sale. The API reserve is not a verified interpretation of the notification's minimum-bid rules.

feesAndInterest.qualification: These are required payment amounts, not payment totals. Null counts mean unknown, not zero. Three visible bidders do not establish how many people paid either charge.

accountPaymentView.observation: In the selected participation summary, payment history returned zero matching records and the successful-payment lookup failed with HTTP 400. Neither response establishes a site-wide payer count or proves that this account has no successful payments elsewhere.

clientLookupContract.referenceIdMeaning: Selected participation bidId, not auction noticeId.
clientLookupContract.sourceVerification: Observed in the public participation client service and summary component.

successfulPaymentDiagnostic.qualification: The error content matched a no-payment/no-record condition for this lookup. This is not a site-wide payment count; the complete backend cause and records outside this reference remain unverified.

observedRequests.purpose: Selected participation's lot, criteria and document summary; includes an EMD-requirement flag, not a verified payer count.
Auction-fee history filtered by paymentType AUCTION_FEE and the selected participation bidId; zero matching records under that request context.
Successful-payment lookup made by the summary view; failed request, not a zero-payment result.

schedule.qualification: Extension duration does not identify the number of bids, bidders or fee payers.

changeEvidence.qualification: Values returned by the refreshed public snapshot; null force-close fields are not independently verified false values.

displaySettings.qualification: Configuration flags alone do not prove live visibility or endpoint authorization.

biddingEvidence.qualification: The normal supplier UI loaded ranks and histories. These are actual bidding observations, not an EMD or participation-fee register.

sources.authenticatedObservationScope: Owner-authorized, read-only UI navigation; only sanitized findings retained.

paymentVerificationLead.observedClientBehavior: The evaluation-workflow component assigns the response to a payment-verification list, then links to details and reconciliation by bidId and paymentType.
paymentVerificationLead.qualification: A potential lead for an authorized auction official, not a verified supplier-accessible payer counter. Payment records may require status filtering and per-person de-duplication.

officialAggregateCountRequest.requestText: For BDA/2026-27/AUCTION4491, Site 303, please provide aggregate counts as of the participation deadline, 31 October 2026 at 17:00: distinct participants with successfully settled Rs. 400,000 EMD; distinct participants with successfully settled Rs. 500 auction fee; and submitted/accepted participation counts. Please de-duplicate payments and report failed, reversed and refunded payments separately, with the cutoff used. No participant names, account numbers or transaction references are requested.

remainingEvidenceNeeded: A site-wide count of distinct successfully settled EMD payers, with a stated cutoff and treatment of refunds, failed payments and duplicates.
A separate site-wide count of distinct successful auction-fee payers; payment transactions and people must not be conflated.
Confirmation of accepted participation and eligibility counts before equating fee payments with competitive bidders.
Official acceptance or award evidence before treating the highest bid as a completed sale.
